{{Short description|Comparison of a wide range of areas}}
[[File:Comparison of units of area.png|thumb|Image comparing various units: [[square mile]] (the entire yellow square), [[square kilometre]], [[hectare]] and [[acre]], as well as a [[soccer field]] and a [[Manhattan]] [[city block|block]].]][[File:1 km2.svg|thumb|right|An area of one [[square kilometre]] consists of 100 [[hectare]]s each containing 10,000 [[square metre]]s.]]
